results.title: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) reports net profit up nearly 800% in H1 2026
results.body: PT Medco Energi Internasional Tbk (MEDC) posted a net profit of US$275.32 million for the first half of 2026, a 796.5% increase from US$30.71 million a year earlier. Revenue rose 23.35% to US$1.41 billion and EBITDA reached US$805 million, while production averaged 170 k barrels of oil equivalent per day, with gas accounting for about 72% of output. Consolidated debt stood at US$4.13 billion against cash of US$1.4 billion, giving a net‑debt‑to‑EBITDA ratio of 1.4×, well below the 2.5× guidance, and electricity sales hit 2,323 GWh, with renewables contributing roughly 25% of the mix. The results were supported by full‑capacity operations at the Senoro Phase 2A smelter, contributions from PT Amman Mineral Internasional, new production sharing contracts in Indonesia and Malaysia, and the company retained its idAA‑ rating from Pefindo with unchanged international ratings.

results.title: RKAB revision delays weigh on mining services issuers; analyst recommends UNTR
results.body: Delays in approving revised RKAB plans until September 2026, affecting about 50 mining companies, create uncertainty for mining services issuers. Analysts note that the 2026 coal production quota is projected at about 600 million tonnes, roughly 24 % lower than 2025, which could reduce contractors' work volume and pressure margins. PT Indo Premier Sekuritas analyst Brigita Kinari and BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Abida Massi Armand stress diversification across commodities and recommend buying UNTR with a target price of Rp 30,600 per share. The impact of the RKAB delay is expected to be most felt in 2027, with diversified issuers likely to recover faster.

results.title: Stocks to Watch as the Fed Raises Interest Rates
results.body: Analysts from Mirae Asset Sekuritas Indonesia and RHB Sekuritas Indonesia recommend focusing on BBCA, BBRI, ELSA, MYOR, MDKA, MIKA, SMSM, LSIP and EXCL, citing consensus 12‑month target prices of Rp8,154, Rp3,851, Rp1,103, Rp2,483, Rp3,961, Rp2,715, Rp2,250, Rp1,933 and Rp3,267 respectively as of 21 September 2026, and noting that a majority of analysts rate BBCA and BBRI as buys. These recommendations follow the Federal Reserve’s 25‑basis‑point rate hike to a 3.75‑4 % target range last week, which is expected to tighten global monetary policy and increase funding costs for Indonesian equities.

results.title: Medco Energi Internasional (MEDC) posts 796% jump in H1 2026 net profit to USD275.3 million.
results.body: Medco Energi Internasional (MEDC) reported first‑half 2026 net profit of USD275.31 million, up 796.77 % year‑on‑year from USD30.7 million. Revenue rose 23.68 % to USD1.41 billion, driven by higher oil‑and‑gas production of 170 k boe per day, improved oil prices and full‑capacity contributions from Amman Mineral (AMMN). The company’s cash cost of oil‑and‑gas production fell to USD8.4 per barrel, net debt stood at ASD4,128 billion with cash of USD1.4 billion, yielding a net‑debt‑to‑EBITDA ratio of 1.4 ×, well below its 2.5 × guidance. Medco maintained its 2026 guidance for production (165‑170 k boe/d) and electricity sales (4,550 GWh), and its idAA‑ rating from Pefindo and unchanged international ratings.

results.title: Foreign Investors Target Top Ten Stocks as IHSG Corrects to 6,384
results.body: Foreign investors were net buyers of the ten most purchased stocks on Monday as the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) corrected to 6,384.72. The IHSG closed at 6,384.72, down 0.88% (56.43 points) with a low of 6,381 and a high of 6,451, total volume of 26.78 billion shares and transaction value of Rp 11.77 trillion, while foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 510.07 billion. The net‑buy amounts were: PT Timah Tbk (TINS) Rp 50.02 billion, PT Petrosea Tbk (PTRO) Rp 37.9 billion, PT Indokripto Koin Semesta Tbk (COIN) Rp 31.19 billion, PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) Rp 29.42 billion, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) Rp 23.11 billion, PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk (AADI) Rp 22.72 billion, PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) Rp 21.51 billion, PT Triputra Agro Persada Tbk (TAPG) Rp 20.91 billion, PT PP London Sumatra Indonesia Tbk (LSIP) Rp 16.09 billion, and PT Folago Global Nusantara Tbk (IRSX) Rp 12.69 billion. In total, 354 stocks fell, 280 rose and 156 were unchanged, making these ten stocks among the net‑buy leaders despite overall foreign net selling.

results.title: Foreign investors net sold Rp 510.07 bn of Indonesian stocks, led by PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI)
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp 510.07 bn on Monday, sending the Indonesia Composite Index (IHSG) down 0.88% to 6,384.72 points. The ten stocks with the largest foreign net outflows were PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) (Rp 140.61 bn), PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) (Rp 139.93 bn), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) (Rp 131.34 bn), PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) (Rp 114.62 bn), PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) (Rp 32.42 bn), PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) (Rp 26.38 bn), PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) (Rp 25.81 bn), PT Alamtri Resoruces Indonesia Tbk (ADRO) (Rp 22.32 bn), PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) (Rp 21.98 bn), and PT Energi Mega Persada Tbk (ENRG) (Rp 16.65 bn). Overall market activity was high, with 26.78 billion shares traded for a total value of Rp 11.77 trillion. Sectorally, infrastructure fell 1.38% while transport rose 0.55%, health gained 0.21% and property remained flat.

results.title: Big bank stocks collectively weaken early in the week as investors adopt a wait-and-see stance ahead of the Bank Indonesia Governor Board meeting.
results.body: The article reports that on Monday 21 September 2026 the stocks of Indonesia’s four big banks – PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI), PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA), PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBNI) and PT Bank Rakyaat Indonesia (BBRI) – all moved lower as investors adopted a wait-and-see stance ahead of the Bank Indonesia Governor Board meeting on 22-23 September. BMRI fell 1.53% to IDR 6,425 (opened at IDR 6,525) and has slipped 2.07% week-on-week, BBCA dropped 1.19% to IDR 6,225 (opened at IDR 6,300) after a 4.23% weekly decline, BBNI lost 0.82% to IDR 3,620 (opened at IDR 3,660) and is down 6.46% over the past week, while BBRI slipped 0.30% to IDR 3,300 (opened at IDR 3,310) after a 2.94% weekly fall. Analysts attribute the synchronized weakness to risk-off sentiment driven by a rupiah near IDR 17,700 per USD, 10-year US Treasury yields around 5%, and uncertainty over global interest-rate direction, while the market expects BI to keep the BI-Rate at 5.75% and the government’s extension of IDR 200 trillion of fund placements in state-owned banks through July 2027 may support liquidity. Despite the pull-back, BCA Sekuritas' Achmad Yaki recommends buying BBNI (target IDR 5,690) and BMRI (target IDR 6,500) and holding BBRI (target IDR 4,400), while Mirae Asset's Nafan Aji Gusta adds buy-add targets of IDR 7,900 for BBCA, IDR 4,020 for BBNI, IDR 4,720 for BMRI and IDR 3,570 for BBRI.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) raises 2026 gold production target to 775,000 ounces
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) revised its 2026 gold production guidance upward to 775,000 ounces, a 34% increase. The revision follows strong first half 2026 performance, with gold content in concentrate reaching 346,354 ounces (up 481% YoY), copper content 211 million pounds (up 136% YoY) and concentrate production 347,307 metric tons dry (up 81% YoY). Financially, net sales rose to US$2.05 billion in the first half, turning a US$146 million loss in H1 2025 into a US$504 million profit in H1 2026, while net debt fell 13% to US$5 billion as of 30 June 2026. The company also set new guidance for copper cathode production of 130,000 tons and pure gold of 350,000 ounces by year-end, reflecting the operational gains.

results.title: UBS AG LDN BRANCH A/C CLIENT increases its stake in PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN)
results.body: UBS AG LDN BRANCH A/C CLIENT increased its shareholding in PT Charoen Pokphand Indonesia Tbk (CPIN) by buying 3,206,900 shares at Rp3,138 each on 16 September 2026, following a prior purchase of 2,261,447 shares at Rp3,141 on 14 September 2026, bringing its total stake to 987.01 million shares (6,0191%). The purchases were made to hedge the client’s derivative trading activities.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reports US$498 million net profit in the first half of 2026, boosted by higher gold grades and increased production targets
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) posted a net profit of US$498 million for the first half of 2026, reversing a US$149 million loss a year earlier and reaching about 49 % of the Stockbit estimate. The improvement was driven by a revised gold‑in‑concentrate target of 775 koz, up 34 % from 579 koz, following a higher ore grade of 0.65 g/t, and by the first‑time announcement of a 130 kt copper‑cathode smelter target after a July 2026 performance guarantee test. Updated JORC reserves at the Batu Hijau mine rose 10.2 % to 777 million tonnes, extending the mine life to 2031‑2032, while the company expects all future revenue to come from smelter products such as copper cathode, gold bars, silver and sulfuric acid. Stockbit Sekuritas remains optimistic for the second half of 2026, citing a projected copper price of US$14 000 per tonne, stable copper price assumptions, and additional by‑product contributions.

results.title: Pending RKAB revisions pressure mining‑service firms; Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia recommends PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR)
results.body: The article discusses how the lack of approval for revised RKAB plans through the end of 2026 creates selective pressure on mining‑service issuers, especially on work volume and heavy‑equipment utilization. Analyst Adrian Djie of Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia notes that contractors with diversified customers and commodities, such as those expanding into gold, nickel and non‑coal minerals, are better positioned, while firms dependent on a few quota‑constrained customers face greater risk. He also advises postponing capital expenditure on new equipment until production volumes for the second half of 2026 become clearer. Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia recommends buying PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) with a target price of Rp28,000 per share.

results.title: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) regains 100% ownership of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE)
results.body: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (TLKM) completed a transaction on 17 September 2026 to acquire the remaining shares of PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE), bringing its ownership to 100%. TLKM purchased 1,445,020 Series A shares and 2,015,637,361,776 Series B shares, representing 19.19% of TDE’s issued and paid‑up capital, increasing its total holding to 10,504,517,594,408 shares. PT Telkom Data Ekosistem (TDE) is a subsidiary of TLKM (99.96% owned) and previously held 0.40% by PT Sigma Cipta Caraka (Telkomsigma), which itself is a TLKM subsidiary (56.39% owned) with the remainder held by PT Multimedia Nusantara, another TLKM subsidiary (99.99% owned). The transaction was disclosed to the Indonesia Stock Exchange and reported to OJK as an affiliated transaction, following a prior Rp2.01‑trillion restructuring in August 2022 that transferred Telkomsigma’s data‑center business to TDE.

results.title: PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT) raises 2026 capex to Rp 23 trillion (excluding GPU) and expects monetization of 5G, FWA and NeoCloud to begin in 2027
results.body: PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT) lifted its 2026 capex guidance to Rp 23 trillion, or about Rp 34 trillion including US$ 628 million for GPU, placing the company in an investment phase for the year. The additional spending will fund 5G network rollout, 5G fixed wireless access and the development of NeoCloud and AI services through Zankore, with the revenue benefits expected to materialize from 2027 onward. Analyst Sukarno Alatas of Kiwoom highlighted that the high capex raises concerns about converting the investment into revenue and EBITDA, especially given higher depreciation, leverage, interest costs and a weak rupiah. He maintains a Hold/Trading‑Sell recommendation with a target price of Rp 2,250 per share, implying a roughly 2.6 % downside from the current price of Rp 2,310.

results.title: Zankore poised to become PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT)'s new growth engine; BRI Danareksa lifts target price to Rp 3,430.
results.body: BRI Danareksa Sekuritas views Zankore, a joint venture between PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT) and strategic partners Ooredoo, NVIDIA, and Nokia, as a new growth engine and raises ISAT's target price to Rp 3,430 per share. The analyst forecasts Zankore to add Rp 405‑810 billion to ISAT earnings in FY27F and Rp 1‑2 trillion in FY28F, notes ISAT's 2026 capex rising to roughly Rp 34 trillion (including US$628 million GPU spend), values ISAT at Rp 2,740‑4,510 per share via a sum‑of‑the‑parts approach, and upgrades the tactical view to Overweight.

results.title: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (SURGE) (WIFI) plans to expand its Edge Data Center network to 529 PoPs by 2026
results.body: PT Solusi Sinergi Digital Tbk (SURGE) (WIFI), a listed issuer on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, announced plans to expand its Edge Data Center business to a total of 529 Points of Presence (PoP) across Indonesia by 2026. The company currently operates 454 PoP in Java, supported by licensing at railway stations, and will add approximately 75 PoP in Sumatra, reaching the 529 PoP target. SURGE expects recurring revenue from services such as colocation, connectivity, CDN, edge cloud, disaster recovery, edge computing, and AI inference, and will seek to increase utilization by attracting customers including ISPs, telecom operators, cloud providers, and SMEs. The expansion leverages SURGE’s integrated network ecosystem—optical backbone, FTTH, 5G fixed wireless access, and CDN—to reduce latency and bandwidth costs, positioning it as a comprehensive digital infrastructure platform.

results.title: Barito Pacific (BRPT) reports 90% of its USD5 bn five‑year capex remains in Indonesia amid regional expansion
results.body: PT Barito Pacific Tbk (BRPT) says that about 90% of its total capital expenditure, roughly USD 5 billion over the past five years, has been allocated to projects in Indonesia despite its regional expansion drive. Vice President Director Rudy Suparman explained that overseas assets are intended to support the Indonesian market while keeping the core business and revenue streams domestic. Its petrochemical subsidiary PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk is constructing a chlor‑alkali and ethylene dichloride (CA‑EDC) plant with an investment of more than US$800 million, 72% complete as of mid‑2026 and slated to start operations in 2027, while renewable energy subsidiary PT Barito Renewables Energy Tbk operates about 1 GW of geothermal and wind capacity and targets exceeding 1 GW of geothermal capacity by the end of 2026. The group also co‑operates the 1,000 MW Jawa 9 and Jawa 10 power plants with Indonesia Power, further reinforcing its domestic energy footprint.

results.title: PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT) projects 2026 revenue of Rp 61.33 trillion and net profit of Rp 6.21 trillion as 5G and AI expansion drives growth
results.body: The article outlines PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison Tbk (ISAT)'s financial outlook as its 5G network and artificial‑intelligence businesses are expected to underpin growth. UBS Global Research projects ISAT’s revenue to climb to Rp 61.33 trillion in 2026, Rp 67.88 trillion in 2027 and Rp 71.22 trillion in 2028, while net profit is expected at Rp 6.21 trillion in 2026 before dropping to Rp 3.87 trillion in 2027 and Rp 3.36 trillion in 2028, then rising again to Rp 8.53 trillion in 2029. The firm plans to raise 2026 capex to roughly Rp 34 trillion, allocating Rp 23 trillion to 5G/FWA expansion, US$ 628 million for GPU‑based AI infrastructure, and launching Lintasarta Neo Cloud in October 2026 and the 200 MW Zankore project in the first half of 2027, which secured US$ 3.1 billion in debt financing covering about 63% of its needs. Analyst recommendations diverge, with Samuel Sekuritas issuing a BUY rating and a target price of Rp 3,000, Bahana assigning a HOLD target of Rp 2,530, and UBS maintaining a SELL target of Rp 2,470, while the report notes competitive capex pressure from PT XL Axiata Tbk (EXCL) and macro risks such as a weakening rupiah and higher funding costs.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reports sales rise to US$ 20.05 billion (up 1.0024%) and net profit of US$ 497.92 million for the first half of 2026
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reported its first‑half 2026 results, turning a net loss of US$ 148.72 million a year earlier into a net profit of US$ 497.92 million. Consolidated sales jumped from US$ 182.59 million in H1 2025 to US$ 20.05 billion, driven by domestic copper cathode sales of US$ 430.7 million, domestic gold sales of US$ 311.06 million, export sales of copper and gold concentrate of US$ 1.07 billion and clean copper cathode exports of US$ 232.19 million. Gross profit rose to US$ 964.15 million on cost of goods sold of US$ 1,088 billion, compared with US$ 55.70 million gross profit and US$ 126.89 million COGS a year earlier. As of June 2026, total assets stood at US$ 13.8 billion, with liabilities of US$ 7.93 billion, equity of US$ 5.86 billion, and cash and cash equivalents of US$ 818.93 million, down from US$ 1.0 billion.

results.title: AMMN reports 435% profit surge and outlines Elang project to replace Batu Hijau
results.body: AMMN posted a net profit of US$497.93 million for the first half of 2026, a 434.81% year‑over‑year increase driven by net sales of US$2.05 billion, 11.24 times higher than a year earlier. The company’s concentrate production rose sharply, with copper concentrate up 136% to 211 million pounds, gold concentrate up 481% to 346,354 ounces, and copper cathode output increasing 146% to 48,756 tons. AMMN revised its 2026 gold concentrate guidance to 775,000 ounces, a 34% increase, while maintaining copper concentrate guidance at 485 million pounds and setting targets of 130,000 tons of copper cathode and 350,000 ounces of gold pure. The firm also announced that the Elang mining project, whose ore reserves are 3.3 times those of Batu Hijau, is slated to begin production in 2031‑2032, positioning it to replace Batu Hijau as the primary source.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reports H1 2026 net profit of USD504 million and a 13% reduction in net debt.
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) announced its audited H1 2026 results, turning a loss in the same period of 2025 into a profit. Net profit reached USD504 million, earnings per share improved to USD0,00688 from a loss of USD0,00205, and net debt fell 13% year‑on‑year. Total net sales surged 1,024% to USD2.05 billion, driven by domestic sales of USD741.77 million and export sales of USD1.31 billion across copper cathode, gold and concentrate products. EBITDA rose 1,207% to USD1,128 billion, while Glencore bought USD1.25 billion (61.1%) of the sales, followed by Aneka Tambang (Antam/ANTM) with USD310.11 million, Marubeni Indonesia with USD231.85 million and Trafigura with USD52.71 million.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) net profit reaches Rp8.89 trillion in H1 2026, supported by gold sales
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reported a net profit of US$497.93 million (approximately Rp8.89 trillion) for the first half of 2026. The result reverses a net loss of US$148.72 million in the same period a year earlier and yields a net profit margin of 24.3%. Revenue jumped more than 1,000% year‑on‑year to US$2.05 billion, driven by domestic final‑product sales of US$741.77 million—including US$311.06 million of pure gold—and export concentrate sales of US$1.08 billion. Gross profit rose 1,630% YoY to US$964.15 million, expanding the gross profit margin to 47% while cost of goods sold increased 757.6% to US$1.09 billion.

results.title: Ubs Ag Ldn Branch A/C Client Buy Shares of Charoen Pokphand Indonesia
results.body: Ubs Ag Ldn Branch A/C Client purchased 3,206,900 Charoen Pokphand Indonesia shares at IDR 3,138 per share on Sept. 16, 2026, costing IDR 10,063,252,200. The buy raised the holder’s stake from 6.000% to 6.019%, increasing its shareholding to 987,012,747 shares. UBS indicated the purchase was made to hedge client derivatives trading activities.

results.title: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) reports net profit of Rp8.89 trillion for the first half of 2026
results.body: PT Amman Mineral Internasional Tbk (AMMN) posted a net profit of US$497.93 million (Rp8.89 trillion) in the first half of 2026, reversing a loss of US$148.72 million a year earlier. Net sales rose sharply to US$2.05 billion (Rp36.61 trillion), driven by a 136% increase in copper production to 211 million pounds and a 481% rise in gold output to 346,354 ounces. The company's largest customer, Glencore, accounted for 61.1% of sales (US$1.25 billion), while PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Marubeni Indonesia contributed 15.1% and 11.3% respectively. Financial expenses increased to US$255.70 million, but pre‑tax profit reached US$695.08 million and equity grew to US$5.86 billion as liabilities fell to US$7.94 billion.

results.title: IHSG down 0.27% as foreign investors sell shares, with PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) among the most traded stocks
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) fell 0.27% to 6,423.51 points in the first session on Monday 21 September, as foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp216.24 billion. Total transaction value on the exchange was Rp5.74 trillion with a volume of 14.28 billion shares, while 329 stocks rose, 291 fell and 168 were unchanged; six of eleven sector indices weakened, led by infrastructure down 0.40% and transport and logistics up 1.47%. PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) and PT Chandra Asri Pacific Tbk (TPIA) posted the highest transaction values at Rp233.97 billion and Rp225.99 billion respectively, with ANTM’s price slipping 1.50% and TPIA’s climbing 3.27%. PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (BBRI) and PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) were among the top net foreign sell stocks, with outflows of Rp19.05 billion and Rp50.77 billion respectively.

results.title: Hery Buys Shares of Charoen Pokphand Indonesia
results.body: On September 16, 2026, insider Hery purchased 6,950,000 Charoen Pokphand Indonesia shares at IDR 3,090 per share, costing IDR 21,475,500,000. The transaction raised Hery’s holding to 912,490,960 shares, lifting his ownership stake from 5.520% to 5.560%. The purchase was executed on behalf of indirect shareholder Royalton Equities Corp and its affiliates through UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd and Bonham Nominees Pte Ltd.

results.title: PT Adhi Karya Tbk (ADHI) signs Master Restructuring Agreement for Rp 3 trillion debt
results.body: PT Adhi Karya Tbk (ADHI) signed a Master Restructuring Agreement (MRA) on 18 September 2026 to restructure its total debt of approximately Rp 3 trillion. The agreement is with the creditor banks PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI), PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) and PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI), with BMRI also serving as the facility agent. Under the MRA, Tranche A provides a term loan of Rp 1,546,885,366,367 with a 15‑year balloon payment and a 3.5 % annual interest (1 % cash quarterly and 2.5 % deferred to 2041); Tranche B supplies a term loan of Rp 1,455,728,987,624 with a 5‑year bullet payment, a 1 % annual interest paid quarterly and funded by ADHI’s divestments; Tranche C covers interest‑free profit‑sharing accrued from the stand‑still period and will be repaid in equal installments over 18 months from the effective date. The restructuring aims to preserve ADHI’s business continuity, improve its operational and financial performance, and enable full repayment of its obligations to the creditor banks.

results.title: Foreign Investors Net Sold Rp2.9 trillion in the Week of 14–18 September 2026, Led by PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI) and PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS)
results.body: Foreign investors recorded a net sell of Rp2.9 trillion during the week of 14–18 September 2026, pushing the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) down 1.53% to 6,441. The largest net outflow was in PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk (BMRI), which saw a sell of Rp702.5 billion and a 2.29% price decline to Rp4,260 per share. In contrast, PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS) attracted the biggest net purchase of Rp367.13 billion, lifting its share price 6.67% to Rp720. The weekly activity contributed to a cumulative foreign net sell of Rp101 trillion in the regular market for 2026.

results.title: IHSG Forecast to Test 6.633 This Week, with Analyst Recommendations for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM), PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk (MTEL) and PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC).
results.body: Indo Premier Sekuritas projects the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to test the 6,633 level this week, with support at 6,200‑6,279 and resistance at 6,585‑6,633 after the index closed at 6,441.16 below the MA5‑MA20 dead‑cross but still above the MA60. The broker recommends PT Aneka Tambang Tbk (ANTM) with a target price of Rp3,710 and a stop‑loss at Rp3,110, PT Dayamitra Telekomunikasi Tbk (MTEL) with a target of Rp535 and stop‑loss at Rp484, and PT Impack Pratama Industri Tbk (IMPC) with a target of Rp1,825 and stop‑loss at Rp1,630, citing solid technical structures for each. The outlook follows recent global monetary tightening, including a 25‑basis‑point Fed rate hike and a BOJ rate increase, which contributed to a 1.53% weekly decline in IHSG and net foreign outflows of Rp2.9 trillion.

results.title: Today's Stock Recommendations: ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI
results.body: The article recommends buying ANTM, VKTR, and MAPI while noting that the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) closed at 6,441.16, down 0.33% on 18 September 2026, with foreign investors net selling about Rp1.79 trillion. It points out that the technology sector was the only sector to gain (+0.27%) as most other sectors weakened, and that FTSE rebalancing triggered the largest net sell since 19 June, affecting micro‑cap stocks BSDE, SCMA and BBYB. Corporate updates include ERAA’s plan to expand its food‑and‑beverage portfolio through its subsidiary Erajaya Food & Nourishment (EFN), BIKE’s subsidiary Ratu Karya signing a MoU with Perumda Pasar Jaya for a Rp1 trillion Pasar Minggu development, and ULTJ’s rights issue to fund the acquisition of 100 % of Frisian Flag Indonesia for Rp14.57 trillion, after which FrieslandCampina International Holding B.V. (FCIH) will become the controlling shareholder. The rights issue will issue up to 7.88 billion new shares at Rp2,150 each, representing 43.11 % of post‑issue capital and raising up to Rp16.94 trillion, with the transaction valued at 178.24 % of ULTJ’s equity and pending approval at the RUPSLB on 27 October 2026.

results.title: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) signs Master Restructuring Agreement to restructure Rp3 trillion of debt
results.body: PT Adhi Karya (Persero) Tbk (ADHI) signed a Master Restructuring Agreement (MRA) on 18 September 2026 to restructure its Rp3 trillion debt. The agreement, reached with creditor banks PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) (BMRI) Tbk, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) (BBRI) Tbk and PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) (BBNI) Tbk, splits the debt into three tranches: Tranche A of Rp1.55 trillion with 3.5% annual interest (1% cash quarterly, 2.5% deferred to 2041), Tranche B of Rp1.46 trillion with 1% annual interest payable quarterly over five years, and Tranche C covering interest or profit‑sharing payable in interest‑free installments over 18 months. The MRA becomes effective after shareholder approval at the upcoming RUPS and fulfillment of the agreement’s conditions, as noted by President Director Moeharmein Zein Chaniago. ADHI will refocus on its core engineering and construction business, streamline its organization and portfolio, and aim to improve operational efficiency and financial management.
